{"parentUuid":"0e6deaf0-cf2e-4536-ab5f-341207ecc17e","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"f2d02e12-8c36-4cb3-8389-8a1a2023ce46","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01XRDyP4GrWfhKKjzfDMXR8J","type":"tool_result","content":"\"\"\"Accounts: users, password hashing, login and logout, and sessions.\n\nPasswords are only ever stored as argon2 hashes and never logged. A session is\na random id kept in the `sessions` table; the browser holds it inside a signed\ncookie (see app/web.py), so logging out deletes the row and ends the session\neven if someone kept a copy of the cookie.\n\nAnything the console should refuse raises `Refused` with a message to show.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport secrets\nimport sqlite3\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass\n\nfrom argon2 import PasswordHasher\nfrom argon2.exceptions import VerifyMismatchError\n\n_hasher = PasswordHasher()\n# Checked against when the email is unknown, so that a wrong email takes as\n# long to refuse as a wrong password and timing doesn't reveal which exist.\n_DUMMY_HASH = _hasher.hash(secrets.token_urlsafe(16))\n\nBAD_CREDENTIALS = \"邮箱或密码错误。\"\nDISPLAY_NAME_TAKEN = \"该昵称已被使用，请换一个。\"\n\n\nclass Refused(Exception):\n    \"\"\"An account action the console refuses, with the reason to show.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, message: str) -> None:\n        super().__init__(message)\n        self.message = message\n\n\nclass AccountDeactivated(Refused):\n    \"\"\"The password was right, but the account is Deactivated.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self) -> None:\n        super().__init__(\"账号已停用，无法登录。如有疑问，请联系管理员。\")\n\n\n# A role is a bundle of capabilities. Code asks `user.can(...)`, never which\n# role someone has, so a rule can move between roles without touching callers.\nCAPABILITIES: dict[str, frozenset[str]] = {\n    \"admin\": frozenset({\n        \"publish_guides\",      # Publish Submitted Guides, and their own Drafts;\n                               # Return and Unpublish Guides\n        \"manage_all_guides\",   # see and edit everyone's Guides, any Hero\n        \"edit_guide_slugs\",\n        \"manage_trash\",        # see the Trash, restore from it, delete for good\n        \"manage_game\",         # Heroes and Patches\n        \"build_site\",          # 更新网站: the Site build and deploy\n    }),\n    \"editor\": frozenset(),\n}\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass User:\n    id: int\n    email: str\n    role: str\n    display_name: str | None\n    state: str\n    needs_setup: bool\n\n    def can(self, capability: str) -> bool:\n        return capability in CAPABILITIES[self.role]\n\n\ndef _user_from_row(row: sqlite3.Row) -> User:\n    return User(id=row[\"id\"], email=row[\"email\"], role=row[\"role\"],\n                display_name=row[\"display_name\"], state=row[\"state\"],\n                needs_setup=bool(row[\"needs_setup\"]))\n\n\ndef _matches(password_hash: str, password: str) -> bool:\n    try:\n        return _hasher.verify(password_hash, password)\n    except VerifyMismatchError:\n        return False\n\n\ndef _normalise_email(email: str) -> str:\n    return email.strip().lower()\n\n\ndef create_user(conn: sqlite3.Connection, *, email: str, password: str,\n                role: str, display_name: str | None = None,\n                needs_setup: bool = False, state: str = \"active\") -> User:\n    \"\"\"Raises Refused if the email or Display name already belongs to someone.\"\"\"\n    try:\n        cur = conn.execute(\n            \"INSERT INTO users (email, password_hash, role, display_name,\"\n            \" needs_setup, state) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)\",\n            (_normalise_email(email), _hasher.hash(password), role, display_name,\n             int(needs_setup), state),\n        )\n    except sqlite3.IntegrityError as error:\n        if \"users.email\" in str(error):\n            raise Refused(\"该邮箱已有账号。\") from None\n        if \"users.display_name\" in str(error):\n            raise Refused(DISPLAY_NAME_TAKEN) from None\n        raise\n    row = conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = ?\", (cur.lastrowid,)).fetchone()\n    return _user_from_row(row)\n\n\ndef user_with_email(conn: sqlite3.Connection, email: str) -> User | None:\n    row = conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM users WHERE email = ?\",\n                       (_normalise_email(email),)).fetchone()\n    return _user_from_row(row) if row else None\n\n\ndef log_in(conn: sqlite3.Connection, email: str, password: str) -> tuple[str, User]:\n    \"\"\"Check the credentials and start a session.\n    Returns the session id and the signed-in user.\"\"\"\n    row = conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM users WHERE email = ?\",\n                       (_normalise_email(email),)).fetchone()\n    # Hash-check first, even for an unknown email, so both take the same time.\n    password_ok = _matches(row[\"password_hash\"] if row else _DUMMY_HASH, password)\n    if row is None or not password_ok:\n        raise Refused(BAD_CREDENTIALS)\n    # Only told after the right password, so the state reveals nothing either.\n    if row[\"state\"] == \"deactivated\":\n        raise AccountDeactivated\n    session_id = secrets.token_urlsafe(32)\n    conn.execute(\"INSERT INTO sessions (id, user_id) VALUES (?, ?)\",\n                 (session_id, row[\"id\"]))\n    return session_id, _user_from_row(row)\n\n\ndef log_out(conn: sqlite3.Connection, session_id: str | None) -> None:\n    conn.execute(\"DELETE FROM sessions WHERE id = ?\", (session_id,))\n\n\nMIN_PASSWORD_LENGTH = 8\nMAX_DISPLAY_NAME_LENGTH = 30\n\n\ndef complete_setup(conn: sqlite3.Connection, user: User, *, display_name: str,\n                   password: str, password_confirm: str) -> None:\n    \"\"\"First-login setup: the user replaces their temporary password and\n    chooses their Display name. Raises Refused if either is unacceptable.\"\"\"\n    display_name = display_name.strip()\n    if not display_name:\n        raise Refused(\"请填写昵称。\")\n    if len(display_name) > MAX_DISPLAY_NAME_LENGTH:\n        raise Refused(f\"昵称最多 {MAX_DISPLAY_NAME_LENGTH} 个字符。\")\n    if display_name.lower() == user.email.lower():\n        raise Refused(\"昵称不能是登录邮箱，昵称会公开显示。\")\n    if len(password) < MIN_PASSWORD_LENGTH:\n        raise Refused(f\"密码至少需要 {MIN_PASSWORD_LENGTH} 个字符。\")\n    if password != password_confirm:\n        raise Refused(\"两次输入的密码不一致。\")\n    current = conn.execute(\"SELECT password_hash FROM users WHERE id = ?\",\n                           (user.id,)).fetchone()\n    if _matches(current[\"password_hash\"], password):\n        raise Refused(\"新密码不能与临时密码相同。\")\n    try:\n        conn.execute(\n            \"UPDATE users SET display_name = ?, password_hash = ?, needs_setup = 0\"\n            \" WHERE id = ?\", (display_name, _hasher.hash(password), user.id))\n    except sqlite3.IntegrityError:\n        raise Refused(DISPLAY_NAME_TAKEN) from None\n\n\ndef set_state(conn: sqlite3.Connection, email: str, state: str) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Put an account into a state: active, submission_ban or deactivated.\n    A Deactivated account's open sessions stop working at once.\"\"\"\n    conn.execute(\"UPDATE users SET state = ? WHERE email = ?\",\n                 (state, _normalise_email(email)))\n\n\ndef user_for_session(conn: sqlite3.Connection, session_id: str | None) -> User | None:\n    \"\"\"The user a session belongs to, or None if the session is gone or the\n    account has been Deactivated since it was opened.\"\"\"\n    if not session_id:\n        return None\n    row = conn.execute(\n        \"SELECT users.* FROM sessions JOIN users ON users.id = sessions.user_id\"\n        \" WHERE sessions.id = ? AND users.state != 'deactivated'\",\n        (session_id,)).fetchone()\n    return _user_from_row(row) if row else None\n\"\"\"SQLite storage. The database lives at CMS_DATABASE and is never committed.\n\nThe schema is created on connect (every statement is IF NOT EXISTS), so a fresh\nclone and a fresh test database need no separate setup step. A database made\nbefore a table gained a column gets the column added on connect (see\nADDED_COLUMNS); a schema change that adding columns can't express needs a new\ntable instead.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport sqlite3\nfrom collections.abc import Iterator\nfrom contextlib import contextmanager\n\nfrom app import settings\n\n# The time now, to the millisecond, for timestamps compared with the last Site\n# build: a Guide Published in the same second as a Site build still counts.\nNOW = \"strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%f', 'now')\"\n\nSCHEMA = f\"\"\"\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users (\n    id            INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,\n    email         TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE COLLATE NOCASE,\n    password_hash TEXT NOT NULL,\n    role          TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (role IN ('admin', 'editor')),\n    display_name  TEXT UNIQUE COLLATE NOCASE,\n    state         TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active'\n                  CHECK (state IN ('active', 'submission_ban', 'deactivated')),\n    needs_setup   INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,\n    created_at    TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n);\n\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sessions (\n    id         TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n    user_id    INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n);\n\n-- A Game Term's slug is set only for Heroes (NULLs never clash in UNIQUE).\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS game_terms (\n    id      INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,\n    kind    TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('hero', 'item', 'skill', 'enchantment',\n                                          'monster', 'merchant', 'event')),\n    name_zh TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (name_zh != ''),\n    name_en TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (name_en != ''),\n    slug    TEXT,\n    UNIQUE (kind, slug)\n);\n\n-- The Current Patch is the one added most recently (the highest id).\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS patches (\n    id         INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,\n    name       TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK (name != ''),\n    created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n);\n\n-- A Guide's slug is filled in right after its row is created, since it ends\n-- with the Guide's own id. Status changes only through app/guides.py.\n-- A Guide is in the Trash while trashed_at is set (added in T06, as is\n-- restored_at; see ADDED_COLUMNS). That is separate from its status, so a\n-- restored Guide comes back exactly as it was; restored_at is when it last\n-- came back.\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS guides (\n    id           INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,\n    slug         TEXT UNIQUE,\n    title_zh     TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',\n    body_zh      TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',\n    title_en     TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',\n    body_en      TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',\n    hero_id      INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES game_terms (id),\n    patch_id     INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES patches (id),\n    author_id    INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id),\n    status       TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft'\n                 CHECK (status IN ('draft', 'submitted', 'published')),\n    created_at   TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ({NOW}),\n    updated_at   TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ({NOW}),\n    published_at TEXT\n);\n\n-- A Revision is a pending change to a Published Guide, at most one per Guide.\n-- Publishing it copies it over the Guide and deletes it. base_updated_at is\n-- the Guide's updated_at when the Revision was opened, to tell whether the\n-- Guide changed since. Ids are never reused (AUTOINCREMENT), since review\n-- rounds keep the id of the Revision they Returned after it is gone.\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS revisions (\n    id         INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    guide_id   INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES guides (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    base_updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,\n    title_zh   TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',\n    body_zh    TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',\n    title_en   TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',\n    body_en    TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',\n    hero_id    INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES game_terms (id),\n    patch_id   INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES patches (id),\n    status     TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft' CHECK (status IN ('draft', 'submitted')),\n    created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ({NOW}),\n    updated_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ({NOW})\n);\n\n-- Each Return or Unpublish is a review round, kept for the Guide's history.\n-- A Draft with a Return or Unpublish behind it came back to its Author: a\n-- Guide only leaves Submitted or Published for Draft through one.\n-- A Return of a Revision records the Revision's id (revision_id; added in T06,\n-- see ADDED_COLUMNS). It belongs to that Revision while it is open and joins\n-- the Guide's own history once it is gone.\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS review_rounds (\n    id         INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,\n    guide_id   INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES guides (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    admin_id   INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id),\n    kind       TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('return', 'unpublish')),\n    created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ({NOW})\n);\n\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS review_notes (\n    id       INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,\n    round_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES review_rounds (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    quote    TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (quote != ''),\n    advice   TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (advice != '')\n);\n\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS review_rounds_by_guide ON review_rounds (guide_id);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS review_notes_by_round ON review_notes (round_id);\n\n-- One row per successful Site build, at the time it started reading content.\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS site_builds (\n    id         INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,\n    started_at TEXT NOT NULL\n);\n\n-- Published Guides deleted for good from the Trash. Their rows are gone, so\n-- this is how the dashboard still counts them as a change not on the site.\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS removed_guides (\n    guide_id   INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    removed_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ({NOW})\n);\n\"\"\"\n\n# Columns added to a table after it was first created: (table, column, type).\n# CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS leaves an older table as it was, so connect()\n# adds whichever of these it lacks.\nADDED_COLUMNS = [\n    (\"guides\", \"trashed_at\", \"TEXT\"),\n    (\"guides\", \"restored_at\", \"TEXT\"),\n    (\"review_rounds\", \"revision_id\", \"INTEGER\"),\n]\n\n# Indexes on added columns, made once the columns are sure to exist.\nINDEXES = \"\"\"\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS review_rounds_by_revision ON review_rounds (revision_id);\n\"\"\"\n\n\ndef _add_missing_columns(conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> None:\n    for table, column, type_ in ADDED_COLUMNS:\n        existing = {row[\"name\"] for row in conn.execute(f\"PRAGMA table_info({table})\")}\n        if column not in existing:\n            conn.execute(f\"ALTER TABLE {table} ADD COLUMN {column} {type_}\")\n\n\n@contextmanager\ndef connect() -> Iterator[sqlite3.Connection]:\n    \"\"\"Open the database, commit if the block succeeds, and always close.\"\"\"\n    conn = sqlite3.connect(settings.database_path())\n    conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row\n    conn.execute(\"PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON\")\n    try:\n        conn.executescript(SCHEMA)\n        _add_missing_columns(conn)\n        conn.executescript(INDEXES)\n        yield conn\n        conn.commit()\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\"\"\"Console plumbing shared by every route: templates, the signed session\ncookie, CSRF tokens, flash messages, and the signed-in guard.\n\nThe session cookie (Starlette's SessionMiddleware, signed with itsdangerous\nusing CMS_SECRET_KEY) holds only three things: the session id, the CSRF token,\nand pending flash messages. Who is signed in is decided by the `sessions`\ntable, never by the cookie alone.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport secrets\n\nfrom fastapi import Request\nfrom fastapi.responses import PlainTextResponse, RedirectResponse\nfrom fastapi.templating import Jinja2Templates\n\nfrom app import accounts, db, settings\n\nSESSION_COOKIE = \"cms_session\"\nSESSION_MAX_AGE = 12 * 60 * 60  # seconds; sign in again after half a day\n\ntemplates = Jinja2Templates(directory=str(settings.TEMPLATES))\n\n\ndef csrf_token(request: Request) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The token every console form carries as a hidden `csrf_token` field.\"\"\"\n    token = request.session.get(\"csrf\")\n    if not token:\n        token = request.session[\"csrf\"] = secrets.token_urlsafe(32)\n    return token\n\n\nSAFE_METHODS = {\"GET\", \"HEAD\", \"OPTIONS\"}\n\n\nclass CsrfRejected(Exception):\n    \"\"\"A state-changing request whose form lacks this session's token.\"\"\"\n\n\nasync def verify_csrf(request: Request) -> None:\n    \"\"\"App-wide dependency: every POST (or other unsafe method) must carry the\n    session's CSRF token in its form, or it is refused before the route runs.\"\"\"\n    if request.method in SAFE_METHODS:\n        return\n    expected = request.session.get(\"csrf\")\n    sent = (await request.form()).get(\"csrf_token\")\n    if not expected or not isinstance(sent, str) or not secrets.compare_digest(sent, expected):\n        raise CsrfRejected\n\n\nasync def csrf_rejected_handler(request: Request, exc: Exception) -> PlainTextResponse:\n    return PlainTextResponse(\"请求已过期或来源不明，请返回刷新页面后重试。\",\n                             status_code=403)\n\n\ndef flash(request: Request, message: str, kind: str = \"success\") -> None:\n    \"\"\"Queue a message for the next page shown. kind: success | error.\"\"\"\n    request.session.setdefault(\"flash\", []).append([kind, message])\n\n\ndef pop_flashes(request: Request) -> list[list[str]]:\n    return request.session.pop(\"flash\", [])\n\n\ndef console_root(request: Request) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The relative path from this page back to the console root (\"\" at\n    /login, \"../\" at /admin/guides, \"../../../\" at /admin/guides/5/edit).\n    Templates put it in front of every console link, so no link is\n    root-absolute and none depends on which route rendered the page. A\n    mount prefix (root_path) is part of the console root, so it is not\n    climbed out of.\"\"\"\n    path = request.url.path.removeprefix(request.scope.get(\"root_path\", \"\"))\n    return \"../\" * (path.count(\"/\") - 1)\n\n\ntemplates.env.globals[\"csrf_token\"] = csrf_token\ntemplates.env.globals[\"pop_flashes\"] = pop_flashes\ntemplates.env.globals[\"console_root\"] = console_root\n\n\ndef start_session(request: Request, session_id: str) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Replace the cookie's contents, so nothing from before login survives\n    (the CSRF token is reissued on the next page).\"\"\"\n    request.session.clear()\n    request.session[\"sid\"] = session_id\n\n\nclass LoginRequired(Exception):\n    \"\"\"Raised when nobody is signed in; answered with a redirect to /login.\"\"\"\n\n\nclass SetupRequired(Exception):\n    \"\"\"Raised when the user still has first-login setup to do; answered with a\n    redirect to /admin/setup.\"\"\"\n\n\ndef signed_in_user_mid_setup(request: Request) -> accounts.User:\n    \"\"\"Dependency for the setup page only: the signed-in user, whether or not\n    they have finished first-login setup.\"\"\"\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        user = accounts.user_for_session(conn, request.session.get(\"sid\"))\n    if user is None:\n        raise LoginRequired\n    return user\n\n\ndef signed_in_user(request: Request) -> accounts.User:\n    \"\"\"Dependency for every other console page: the signed-in user, who has\n    finished first-login setup. Anyone else is redirected.\"\"\"\n    user = signed_in_user_mid_setup(request)\n    if user.needs_setup:\n        raise SetupRequired\n    return user\n\n\nclass AdminRequired(Exception):\n    \"\"\"Raised when an Editor reaches an Admin-only page; answered with 403.\"\"\"\n\n\ndef admin_user(request: Request) -> accounts.User:\n    \"\"\"Dependency for Admin-only pages: the signed-in Admin. Editors are\n    refused, whether they followed a link or typed the URL.\"\"\"\n    user = signed_in_user(request)\n    if not user.can(\"manage_game\"):\n        raise AdminRequired\n    return user\n\n\ndef home_for(user: accounts.User) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Where a signed-in user belongs: setup first, then the dashboard.\"\"\"\n    return \"/admin/setup\" if user.needs_setup else \"/admin/dashboard\"\n\n\ndef redirect(url: str) -> RedirectResponse:\n    return RedirectResponse(url, status_code=303)\n\n\nasync def login_required_handler(request: Request, exc: Exception) -> RedirectResponse:\n    return redirect(\"/login\")\n\n\nasync def admin_required_handler(request: Request, exc: Exception) -> PlainTextResponse:\n    return PlainTextResponse(\"只有管理员可以使用此页面。\", status_code=403)\n\n\nasync def setup_required_handler(request: Request, exc: Exception) -> RedirectResponse:\n    return redirect(\"/admin/setup\")\n\"\"\"Login, logout, and first-login  session_id, user = accounts.log_in(conn, email, password)\n    except accounts.Refused as refused:\n        return templates.TemplateResponse(\n            request, \"admin/login.html\",\n            {\"title\": \"登录\", \"email\": email, \"error\": refused.message},\n            status_code=403 if isinstance(refused, accounts.AccountDeactivated)\n            else 401)\n    start_session(request, admin console answers at /admin and the public site answers at /.\nTicket routes live in their own modules under app/routes/ and are included\nhere. Keep this file small.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom fastapi import Depends, FastAPI, Request\nfrom starlette.middleware.sessions import SessionMiddleware\n\nfrom app import settings, web\nfrom app.routes import auth, dashboard, game, guides, site, trash\nfrom app.web import templates\n\n\ndef create_app() -> FastAPI:\n    app = FastAPI(title=\"IPHS 400 MP2 CMS\",\n                  dependencies=[Depends(web.verify_csrf)])\n    app.add_middleware(SessionMiddleware, secret_key=settings.SECRET_KEY,\n                       session_cookie=web.SESSION_COOKIE,\n                       max_age=web.SESSION_MAX_AGE, same_site=\"lax\")\n    app.add_exception_handler(web.LoginRequired, web.login_required_handler)\n    app.add_exception_handler(web.SetupRequired, web.setup_required_handler)\n    app.add_exception_handler(web.AdminRequired, web.admin_required_handler)\n    app.add_exception_handler(web.CsrfRejected, web.csrf_rejected_handler)\n\n    @app.get(\"/admin\")\n    def admin_home(request: Request):\n        return templates.TemplateResponse(\n            request, \"admin/hello.html\", {\"title\": \"Admin\"}\n        )\n\n    @app.get(\"/\")\n    def public_home(request: Request):\n        return templates.TemplateResponse(\n            request, \"public/home.html\",\n            {\"title\": settings.SITE_TITLE, \"items\": []},\n        )\n\n    app.include_router(auth.router)\n    app.include_router(dashboard.router)\n    app.include_router(game.router)\n    app.include_router(guides.router)\n    app.include_router(site.router)\n    app.include_router(trash.router)\n    return app\n\n\napp = create_app()","is_error":false}]},"uuid":"5d7addd3-628c-4459-9028-0c01b25f5ae7","timestamp":"2026-10-18T00:45:03.322Z","toolUseResult":{"stdout":"\"\"\"Accounts: users, password hashing, login and logout, and sessions.\n\nPasswords are only ever stored as argon2 hashes and never logged. A session is\na random id kept in the `sessions` table; the browser holds it inside a signed\ncookie (see app/web.py), so logging out deletes the row and ends the session\neven if someone kept a copy of the cookie.\n\nAnything the console should refuse raises `Refused` with a message to show.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport secrets\nimport sqlite3\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass\n\nfrom argon2 import PasswordHasher\nfrom argon2.exceptions import VerifyMismatchError\n\n_hasher = PasswordHasher()\n# Checked against when the email is unknown, so that a wrong email takes as\n# long to refuse as a wrong password and timing doesn't reveal which exist.\n_DUMMY_HASH = _hasher.hash(secrets.token_urlsafe(16))\n\nBAD_CREDENTIALS = \"邮箱或密码错误。\"\nDISPLAY_NAME_TAKEN = \"该昵称已被使用，请换一个。\"\n\n\nclass Refused(Exception):\n    \"\"\"An account action the console refuses, with the reason to show.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, message: str) -> None:\n        super().__init__(message)\n        self.message = message\n\n\nclass AccountDeactivated(Refused):\n    \"\"\"The password was right, but the account is Deactivated.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self) -> None:\n        super().__init__(\"账号已停用，无法登录。如有疑问，请联系管理员。\")\n\n\n# A role is a bundle of capabilities. Code asks `user.can(...)`, never which\n# role someone has, so a rule can move between roles without touching callers.\nCAPABILITIES: dict[str, frozenset[str]] = {\n    \"admin\": frozenset({\n        \"publish_guides\",      # Publish Submitted Guides, and their own Drafts;\n                               # Return and Unpublish Guides\n        \"manage_all_guides\",   # see and edit everyone's Guides, any Hero\n        \"edit_guide_slugs\",\n        \"manage_trash\",        # see the Trash, restore from it, delete for good\n        \"manage_game\",         # Heroes and Patches\n        \"build_site\",          # 更新网站: the Site build and deploy\n    }),\n    \"editor\": frozenset(),\n}\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass User:\n    id: int\n    email: str\n    role: str\n    display_name: str | None\n    state: str\n    needs_setup: bool\n\n    def can(self, capability: str) -> bool:\n        return capability in CAPABILITIES[self.role]\n\n\ndef _user_from_row(row: sqlite3.Row) -> User:\n    return User(id=row[\"id\"], email=row[\"email\"], role=row[\"role\"],\n                display_name=row[\"display_name\"], state=row[\"state\"],\n                needs_setup=bool(row[\"needs_setup\"]))\n\n\ndef _matches(password_hash: str, password: str) -> bool:\n    try:\n        return _hasher.verify(password_hash, password)\n    except VerifyMismatchError:\n        return False\n\n\ndef _normalise_email(email: str) -> str:\n    return email.strip().lower()\n\n\ndef create_user(conn: sqlite3.Connection, *, email: str, password: str,\n                role: str, display_name: str | None = None,\n                needs_setup: bool = False, state: str = \"active\") -> User:\n    \"\"\"Raises Refused if the email or Display name already belongs to someone.\"\"\"\n    try:\n        cur = conn.execute(\n            \"INSERT INTO users (email, password_hash, role, display_name,\"\n            \" needs_setup, state) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)\",\n            (_normalise_email(email), _hasher.hash(password), role, display_name,\n             int(needs_setup), state),\n        )\n    except sqlite3.IntegrityError as error:\n        if \"users.email\" in str(error):\n            raise Refused(\"该邮箱已有账号。\") from None\n        if \"users.display_name\" in str(error):\n            raise Refused(DISPLAY_NAME_TAKEN) from None\n        raise\n    row = conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = ?\", (cur.lastrowid,)).fetchone()\n    return _user_from_row(row)\n\n\ndef user_with_email(conn: sqlite3.Connection, email: str) -> User | None:\n    row = conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM users WHERE email = ?\",\n                       (_normalise_email(email),)).fetchone()\n    return _user_from_row(row) if row else None\n\n\ndef log_in(conn: sqlite3.Connection, email: str, password: str) -> tuple[str, User]:\n    \"\"\"Check the credentials and start a session.\n    Returns the session id and the signed-in user.\"\"\"\n    row = conn.execute(\"SELECT * FROM users WHERE email = ?\",\n                       (_normalise_email(email),)).fetchone()\n    # Hash-check first, even for an unknown email, so both take the same time.\n    password_ok = _matches(row[\"password_hash\"] if row else _DUMMY_HASH, password)\n    if row is None or not password_ok:\n        raise Refused(BAD_CREDENTIALS)\n    # Only told after the right password, so the state reveals nothing either.\n    if row[\"state\"] == \"deactivated\":\n        raise AccountDeactivated\n    session_id = secrets.token_urlsafe(32)\n    conn.execute(\"INSERT INTO sessions (id, user_id) VALUES (?, ?)\",\n                 (session_id, row[\"id\"]))\n    return session_id, _user_from_row(row)\n\n\ndef log_out(conn: sqlite3.Connection, session_id: str | None) -> None:\n    conn.execute(\"DELETE FROM sessions WHERE id = ?\", (session_id,))\n\n\nMIN_PASSWORD_LENGTH = 8\nMAX_DISPLAY_NAME_LENGTH = 30\n\n\ndef complete_setup(conn: sqlite3.Connection, user: User, *, display_name: str,\n                   password: str, password_confirm: str) -> None:\n    \"\"\"First-login setup: the user replaces their temporary password and\n    chooses their Display name. Raises Refused if either is unacceptable.\"\"\"\n    display_name = display_name.strip()\n    if not display_name:\n        raise Refused(\"请填写昵称。\")\n    if len(display_name) > MAX_DISPLAY_NAME_LENGTH:\n        raise Refused(f\"昵称最多 {MAX_DISPLAY_NAME_LENGTH} 个字符。\")\n    if display_name.lower() == user.email.lower():\n        raise Refused(\"昵称不能是登录邮箱，昵称会公开显示。\")\n    if len(password) < MIN_PASSWORD_LENGTH:\n        raise Refused(f\"密码至少需要 {MIN_PASSWORD_LENGTH} 个字符。\")\n    if password != password_confirm:\n        raise Refused(\"两次输入的密码不一致。\")\n    current = conn.execute(\"SELECT password_hash FROM users WHERE id = ?\",\n                           (user.id,)).fetchone()\n    if _matches(current[\"password_hash\"], password):\n        raise Refused(\"新密码不能与临时密码相同。\")\n    try:\n        conn.execute(\n            \"UPDATE users SET display_name = ?, password_hash = ?, needs_setup = 0\"\n            \" WHERE id = ?\", (display_name, _hasher.hash(password), user.id))\n    except sqlite3.IntegrityError:\n        raise Refused(DISPLAY_NAME_TAKEN) from None\n\n\ndef set_state(conn: sqlite3.Connection, email: str, state: str) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Put an account into a state: active, submission_ban or deactivated.\n    A Deactivated account's open sessions stop working at once.\"\"\"\n    conn.execute(\"UPDATE users SET state = ? WHERE email = ?\",\n                 (state, _normalise_email(email)))\n\n\ndef user_for_session(conn: sqlite3.Connection, session_id: str | None) -> User | None:\n    \"\"\"The user a session belongs to, or None if the session is gone or the\n    account has been Deactivated since it was opened.\"\"\"\n    if not session_id:\n        return None\n    row = conn.execute(\n        \"SELECT users.* FROM sessions JOIN users ON users.id = sessions.user_id\"\n        \" WHERE sessions.id = ? AND users.state != 'deactivated'\",\n        (session_id,)).fetchone()\n    return _user_from_row(row) if row else None\n\"\"\"SQLite storage. The database lives at CMS_DATABASE and is never committed.\n\nThe schema is created on connect (every statement is IF NOT EXISTS), so a fresh\nclone and a fresh test database need no separate setup step. A database made\nbefore a table gained a column gets the column added on connect (see\nADDED_COLUMNS); a schema change that adding columns can't express needs a new\ntable instead.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport sqlite3\nfrom collections.abc import Iterator\nfrom contextlib import contextmanager\n\nfrom app import settings\n\n# The time now, to the millisecond, for timestamps compared with the last Site\n# build: a Guide Published in the same second as a Site build still counts.\nNOW = \"strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%f', 'now')\"\n\nSCHEMA = f\"\"\"\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users (\n    id            INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,\n    email         TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE COLLATE NOCASE,\n    password_hash TEXT NOT NULL,\n    role          TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (role IN ('admin', 'editor')),\n    display_name  TEXT UNIQUE COLLATE NOCASE,\n    state         TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active'\n                  CHECK (state IN ('active', 'submission_ban', 'deactivated')),\n    needs_setup   INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,\n    created_at    TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n);\n\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS sessions (\n    id         TEXT PRIMARY KEY,\n    user_id    INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n);\n\n-- A Game Term's slug is set only for Heroes (NULLs never clash in UNIQUE).\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS game_terms (\n    id      INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,\n    kind    TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('hero', 'item', 'skill', 'enchantment',\n                                          'monster', 'merchant', 'event')),\n    name_zh TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (name_zh != ''),\n    name_en TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (name_en != ''),\n    slug    TEXT,\n    UNIQUE (kind, slug)\n);\n\n-- The Current Patch is the one added most recently (the highest id).\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS patches (\n    id         INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,\n    name       TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK (name != ''),\n    created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP\n);\n\n-- A Guide's slug is filled in right after its row is created, since it ends\n-- with the Guide's own id. Status changes only through app/guides.py.\n-- A Guide is in the Trash while trashed_at is set (added in T06, as is\n-- restored_at; see ADDED_COLUMNS). That is separate from its status, so a\n-- restored Guide comes back exactly as it was; restored_at is when it last\n-- came back.\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS guides (\n    id           INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,\n    slug         TEXT UNIQUE,\n    title_zh     TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',\n    body_zh      TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',\n    title_en     TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',\n    body_en      TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',\n    hero_id      INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES game_terms (id),\n    patch_id     INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES patches (id),\n    author_id    INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id),\n    status       TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft'\n                 CHECK (status IN ('draft', 'submitted', 'published')),\n    created_at   TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ({NOW}),\n    updated_at   TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ({NOW}),\n    published_at TEXT\n);\n\n-- A Revision is a pending change to a Published Guide, at most one per Guide.\n-- Publishing it copies it over the Guide and deletes it. base_updated_at is\n-- the Guide's updated_at when the Revision was opened, to tell whether the\n-- Guide changed since. Ids are never reused (AUTOINCREMENT), since review\n-- rounds keep the id of the Revision they Returned after it is gone.\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS revisions (\n    id         INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,\n    guide_id   INTEGER NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES guides (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    base_updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,\n    title_zh   TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',\n    body_zh    TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',\n    title_en   TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',\n    body_en    TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',\n    hero_id    INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES game_terms (id),\n    patch_id   INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES patches (id),\n    status     TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft' CHECK (status IN ('draft', 'submitted')),\n    created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ({NOW}),\n    updated_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ({NOW})\n);\n\n-- Each Return or Unpublish is a review round, kept for the Guide's history.\n-- A Draft with a Return or Unpublish behind it came back to its Author: a\n-- Guide only leaves Submitted or Published for Draft through one.\n-- A Return of a Revision records the Revision's id (revision_id; added in T06,\n-- see ADDED_COLUMNS). It belongs to that Revision while it is open and joins\n-- the Guide's own history once it is gone.\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS review_rounds (\n    id         INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,\n    guide_id   INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES guides (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    admin_id   INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES users (id),\n    kind       TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('return', 'unpublish')),\n    created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ({NOW})\n);\n\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS review_notes (\n    id       INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,\n    round_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES review_rounds (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,\n    quote    TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (quote != ''),\n    advice   TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (advice != '')\n);\n\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS review_rounds_by_guide ON review_rounds (guide_id);\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS review_notes_by_round ON review_notes (round_id);\n\n-- One row per successful Site build, at the time it started reading content.\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS site_builds (\n    id         INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,\n    started_at TEXT NOT NULL\n);\n\n-- Published Guides deleted for good from the Trash. Their rows are gone, so\n-- this is how the dashboard still counts them as a change not on the site.\nCREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS removed_guides (\n    guide_id   INTEGER NOT NULL,\n    removed_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT ({NOW})\n);\n\"\"\"\n\n# Columns added to a table after it was first created: (table, column, type).\n# CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS leaves an older table as it was, so connect()\n# adds whichever of these it lacks.\nADDED_COLUMNS = [\n    (\"guides\", \"trashed_at\", \"TEXT\"),\n    (\"guides\", \"restored_at\", \"TEXT\"),\n    (\"review_rounds\", \"revision_id\", \"INTEGER\"),\n]\n\n# Indexes on added columns, made once the columns are sure to exist.\nINDEXES = \"\"\"\nCREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS review_rounds_by_revision ON review_rounds (revision_id);\n\"\"\"\n\n\ndef _add_missing_columns(conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> None:\n    for table, column, type_ in ADDED_COLUMNS:\n        existing = {row[\"name\"] for row in conn.execute(f\"PRAGMA table_info({table})\")}\n        if column not in existing:\n            conn.execute(f\"ALTER TABLE {table} ADD COLUMN {column} {type_}\")\n\n\n@contextmanager\ndef connect() -> Iterator[sqlite3.Connection]:\n    \"\"\"Open the database, commit if the block succeeds, and always close.\"\"\"\n    conn = sqlite3.connect(settings.database_path())\n    conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row\n    conn.execute(\"PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON\")\n    try:\n        conn.executescript(SCHEMA)\n        _add_missing_columns(conn)\n        conn.executescript(INDEXES)\n        yield conn\n        conn.commit()\n    finally:\n        conn.close()\n\"\"\"Console plumbing shared by every route: templates, the signed session\ncookie, CSRF tokens, flash messages, and the signed-in guard.\n\nThe session cookie (Starlette's SessionMiddleware, signed with itsdangerous\nusing CMS_SECRET_KEY) holds only three things: the session id, the CSRF token,\nand pending flash messages. Who is signed in is decided by the `sessions`\ntable, never by the cookie alone.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport secrets\n\nfrom fastapi import Request\nfrom fastapi.responses import PlainTextResponse, RedirectResponse\nfrom fastapi.templating import Jinja2Templates\n\nfrom app import accounts, db, settings\n\nSESSION_COOKIE = \"cms_session\"\nSESSION_MAX_AGE = 12 * 60 * 60  # seconds; sign in again after half a day\n\ntemplates = Jinja2Templates(directory=str(settings.TEMPLATES))\n\n\ndef csrf_token(request: Request) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The token every console form carries as a hidden `csrf_token` field.\"\"\"\n    token = request.session.get(\"csrf\")\n    if not token:\n        token = request.session[\"csrf\"] = secrets.token_urlsafe(32)\n    return token\n\n\nSAFE_METHODS = {\"GET\", \"HEAD\", \"OPTIONS\"}\n\n\nclass CsrfRejected(Exception):\n    \"\"\"A state-changing request whose form lacks this session's token.\"\"\"\n\n\nasync def verify_csrf(request: Request) -> None:\n    \"\"\"App-wide dependency: every POST (or other unsafe method) must carry the\n    session's CSRF token in its form, or it is refused before the route runs.\"\"\"\n    if request.method in SAFE_METHODS:\n        return\n    expected = request.session.get(\"csrf\")\n    sent = (await request.form()).get(\"csrf_token\")\n    if not expected or not isinstance(sent, str) or not secrets.compare_digest(sent, expected):\n        raise CsrfRejected\n\n\nasync def csrf_rejected_handler(request: Request, exc: Exception) -> PlainTextResponse:\n    return PlainTextResponse(\"请求已过期或来源不明，请返回刷新页面后重试。\",\n                             status_code=403)\n\n\ndef flash(request: Request, message: str, kind: str = \"success\") -> None:\n    \"\"\"Queue a message for the next page shown. kind: success | error.\"\"\"\n    request.session.setdefault(\"flash\", []).append([kind, message])\n\n\ndef pop_flashes(request: Request) -> list[list[str]]:\n    return request.session.pop(\"flash\", [])\n\n\ndef console_root(request: Request) -> str:\n    \"\"\"The relative path from this page back to the console root (\"\" at\n    /login, \"../\" at /admin/guides, \"../../../\" at /admin/guides/5/edit).\n    Templates put it in front of every console link, so no link is\n    root-absolute and none depends on which route rendered the page. A\n    mount prefix (root_path) is part of the console root, so it is not\n    climbed out of.\"\"\"\n    path = request.url.path.removeprefix(request.scope.get(\"root_path\", \"\"))\n    return \"../\" * (path.count(\"/\") - 1)\n\n\ntemplates.env.globals[\"csrf_token\"] = csrf_token\ntemplates.env.globals[\"pop_flashes\"] = pop_flashes\ntemplates.env.globals[\"console_root\"] = console_root\n\n\ndef start_session(request: Request, session_id: str) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Replace the cookie's contents, so nothing from before login survives\n    (the CSRF token is reissued on the next page).\"\"\"\n    request.session.clear()\n    request.session[\"sid\"] = session_id\n\n\nclass LoginRequired(Exception):\n    \"\"\"Raised when nobody is signed in; answered with a redirect to /login.\"\"\"\n\n\nclass SetupRequired(Exception):\n    \"\"\"Raised when the user still has first-login setup to do; answered with a\n    redirect to /admin/setup.\"\"\"\n\n\ndef signed_in_user_mid_setup(request: Request) -> accounts.User:\n    \"\"\"Dependency for the setup page only: the signed-in user, whether or not\n    they have finished first-login setup.\"\"\"\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        user = accounts.user_for_session(conn, request.session.get(\"sid\"))\n    if user is None:\n        raise LoginRequired\n    return user\n\n\ndef signed_in_user(request: Request) -> accounts.User:\n    \"\"\"Dependency for every other console page: the signed-in user, who has\n    finished first-login setup. Anyone else is redirected.\"\"\"\n    user = signed_in_user_mid_setup(request)\n    if user.needs_setup:\n        raise SetupRequired\n    return user\n\n\nclass AdminRequired(Exception):\n    \"\"\"Raised when an Editor reaches an Admin-only page; answered with 403.\"\"\"\n\n\ndef admin_user(request: Request) -> accounts.User:\n    \"\"\"Dependency for Admin-only pages: the signed-in Admin. Editors are\n    refused, whether they followed a link or typed the URL.\"\"\"\n    user = signed_in_user(request)\n    if not user.can(\"manage_game\"):\n        raise AdminRequired\n    return user\n\n\ndef home_for(user: accounts.User) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Where a signed-in user belongs: setup first, then the dashboard.\"\"\"\n    return \"/admin/setup\" if user.needs_setup else \"/admin/dashboard\"\n\n\ndef redirect(url: str) -> RedirectResponse:\n    return RedirectResponse(url, status_code=303)\n\n\nasync def login_required_handler(request: Request, exc: Exception) -> RedirectResponse:\n    return redirect(\"/login\")\n\n\nasync def admin_required_handler(request: Request, exc: Exception) -> PlainTextResponse:\n    return PlainTextResponse(\"只有管理员可以使用此页面。\", status_code=403)\n\n\nasync def setup_required_handler(request: Request, exc: Exception) -> RedirectResponse:\n    return redirect(\"/admin/setup\")\n\"\"\"Login, logout, and first-login setup.\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom typing import Annotated\n\nfrom fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, Form, Request\n\nfrom app import accounts, db\nfrom app.accounts import User\nfrom app.web import (flash, home_for, redirect, signed_in_user_mid_setup,\n                     start_session, templates)\n\nrouter = APIRouter()\n\n\n@router.get(\"/login\")\ndef login_form(request: Request):\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(request, \"admin/login.html\",\n                                      {\"title\": \"登录\", \"email\": \"\"})\n\n\n@router.post(\"/login\")\ndef login(request: Request, email: Annotated[str, Form()],\n          password: Annotated[str, Form()]):\n    try:\n        with db.connect() as conn:\n            session_id, user = accounts.log_in(conn, email, password)\n    except accounts.Refused as refused:\n        return templates.TemplateResponse(\n            request, \"admin/login.html\",\n            {\"title\": \"登录\", \"email\": email, \"error\": refused.message},\n            status_code=403 if isinstance(refused, accounts.AccountDeactivated)\n            else 401)\n    start_session(request, session_id)\n    return redirect(home_for(user))\n\n\n@router.post(\"/logout\")\ndef logout(request: Request):\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        accounts.log_out(conn, request.session.get(\"sid\"))\n    request.session.clear()\n    flash(request, \"已退出登录。\")\n    return redirect(\"/login\")\n\n\n@router.get(\"/admin/setup\")\ndef setup_form(request: Request,\n               user: Annotated[User, Depends(signed_in_user_mid_setup)]):\n    if not user.needs_setup:\n        return redirect(home_for(user))\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"admin/setup.html\",\n        {\"title\": \"首次登录设置\", \"user\": user, \"display_name\": \"\"})\n\n\n@router.post(\"/admin/setup\")\ndef setup(request: Request,\n          user: Annotated[User, Depends(signed_in_user_mid_setup)],\n          display_name: Annotated[str, Form()], password: Annotated[str, Form()],\n          password_confirm: Annotated[str, Form()]):\n    if not user.needs_setup:\n        return redirect(home_for(user))\n    try:\n        with db.connect() as conn:\n            accounts.complete_setup(conn, user, display_name=display_name,\n                                    password=password,\n                                    password_confirm=password_confirm)\n    except accounts.Refused as refused:\n        return templates.TemplateResponse(\n            request, \"admin/setup.html\",\n            {\"title\": \"首次登录设置\", \"user\": user, \"display_name\": display_name,\n             \"error\": refused.message},\n            status_code=400)\n    flash(request, \"设置完成，欢迎加入！\")\n    return redirect(\"/admin/dashboard\")\n\"\"\"The Trash (回收站): deleted Guides, which only Admins see. They restore a\nGuide from it or delete it for good, through app/guides.py.\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom typing import Annotated\n\nfrom fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, Request\n\nfrom app import db, guides\nfrom app.accounts import User\nfrom app.routes.guides import status_for\nfrom app.web import AdminRequired, flash, redirect, signed_in_user, templates\n\nrouter = APIRouter()\n\n\ndef trash_manager(user: Annotated[User, Depends(signed_in_user)]) -> User:\n    \"\"\"The signed-in Admin; Editors are refused, even by typed URL.\"\"\"\n    if not user.can(\"manage_trash\"):\n        raise AdminRequired\n    return user\n\n\ndef trash_page(request: Request, user: User, *, error: str | None = None,\n               status_code: int = 200):\n    with db.connect() as conn:\n        listed = guides.trashed(conn, user)\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"admin/trash.html\",\n        {\"title\": \"回收站\", \"user\": user, \"guides\": listed, \"error\": error},\n        status_code=status_code)\n\n\n@router.get(\"/admin/trash\")\ndef trash(request: Request, user: Annotated[User, Depends(trash_manager)]):\n    return trash_page(request, user)\n\n\n@router.post(\"/admin/trash/{guide_id}/restore\")\ndef restore(request: Request, guide_id: int,\n            user: Annotated[User, Depends(trash_manager)]):\n    try:\n        with db.connect() as conn:\n            guides.restore(conn, user, guide_id)\n    except guides.Refused as refused:\n        return trash_page(request, user, error=refused.message,\n                          status_code=status_for(refused))\n    flash(request, \"已恢复，攻略原样回到了作者手里。\")\n    return redirect(\"/admin/trash\")\n\n\n\n@router.get(\"/admin/trash/{guide_id}/delete\")\ndef confirm_delete_for_good(request: Request, guide_id: int,\n                            user: Annotated[User, Depends(trash_manager)]):\n    try:\n        with db.connect() as conn:\n            guide = guides.in_trash(conn, user, guide_id)\n    except guides.GuideNotFound:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=404) from None\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"admin/confirm_delete.html\",\n        {\"title\": \"彻底删除攻略\", \"user\": user,\n         \"question\": f\"确定要彻底删除《{guide.title_zh or '（无标题）'}》吗？\",\n         \"consequences\": [\"彻底删除后无法恢复，攻略的正文、审核意见和修订都会一起删除。\"],\n         \"button\": \"彻底删除\", \"action\": f\"admin/trash/{guide_id}/delete\",\n         \"cancel\": \"admin/trash\"})\n\n\n@router.post(\"/admin/trash/{guide_id}/delete\")\ndef delete_for_good(request: Request, guide_id: int,\n                    user: Annotated[User, Depends(trash_manager)]):\n    try:\n        with db.connect() as conn:\n            guides.delete_for_good(conn, user, guide_id)\n    except guides.Refused as refused:\n        return trash_page(request, user, error=refused.message,\n                          status_code=status_for(refused))\n    flash(request, \"已彻底删除。\")\n    return redirect(\"/admin/trash\")\n\"\"\"The FastAPI application.\n\nT00: the admin console answers at /admin and the public site answers at /.\nTicket routes live in their own modules under app/routes/ and are included\nhere. Keep this file small.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom fastapi import Depends, FastAPI, Request\nfrom starlette.middleware.sessions import SessionMiddleware\n\nfrom app import settings, web\nfrom app.routes import auth, dashboard, game, guides, site, trash\nfrom app.web import templates\n\n\ndef create_app() -> FastAPI:\n    app = FastAPI(title=\"IPHS 400 MP2 CMS\",\n                  dependencies=[Depends(web.verify_csrf)])\n    app.add_middleware(SessionMiddleware, secret_key=settings.SECRET_KEY,\n                       session_cookie=web.SESSION_COOKIE,\n                       max_age=web.SESSION_MAX_AGE, same_site=\"lax\")\n    app.add_exception_handler(web.LoginRequired, web.login_required_handler)\n    app.add_exception_handler(web.SetupRequired, @app.get(\"/admin\")\n    def admin_home(request: Request):\n        return templates.TemplateResponse(\n            request, \"admin/hello.html\", {\"title\": \"Admin\"}\n        )\n\n    @app.get(\"/\")\n    def public_home(request: Request):\n        return templates.TemplateResponse(\n            request, \"public/home.html\",\n            {\"title\": settings.SITE_TITLE, \"items\": {"type":"api-request-blob","sessionId":"dfc2e1c8-5d02-4d9b-a713-3c00c333607c","hash":"1520f54db7620016eab578b6cb333226541ebf976849393bfeccb6a19276d6fa","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01XHrrHgxq9J3YkHio4b4pwA","type":"tool_result","content":"app/db.py:29:                  CHECK (state IN ('active', 'submission_ban', 'deactivated')),\napp/guides.py:317:def _check_not_banned(actor: User) -> None:\napp/guides.py:318:    if actor.state == \"submission_ban\":\napp/guides.py:338:    _check_not_banned(actor)\napp/guides.py:685:    _check_not_banned(actor)\napp/accounts.py:170:    \"\"\"Put an account into a state: active, submission_ban or deactivated.\ntests/test_t03_guides.py:532:def test_an_editor_under_a_submission_ban_keeps_drafting_but_cannot_submit(admin):\ntests/test_t03_guides.py:533:    add_user(email=\"banned@example.test\", password=\"banned-pw-123\", role=\"editor\",\ntests/test_t03_guides.py:534:             display_name=\"禁投编辑\", state=\"submission_ban\")\ntests/test_t03_guides.py:535:    banned = TestClient(create_app())\ntests/test_t03_guides.py:536:    login(banned, \"banned@example.test\", \"banned-pw-123\")\ntests/test_t03_guides.py:538:    edit_page = new_guide(banned)\ntests/test_t03_guides.py:539:    assert save(banned, edit_page, title_zh=\"还能继续写\").status_code == 303\ntests/test_t03_guides.py:540:    response = act(banned, edit_page, \"submit\")\ntests/test_t03_guides.py:543:    assert status_of(banned, edit_page) == \"草稿\"\n----\n\"\"\"The Guide workflow: every change to a Guide, and who may make it.\n\nA Guide moves Draft -> Submitted -> Published. An Admin's Return (from\nSubmitted) or Unpublish (from Published) sends it back to its Author as a\nDraft, recorded as a review round with Review notes. Routes never touch a\nGuide's row themselves: they call a function here with the acting user, and it\neither makes the change or raises `Refused` with the reason to show.\n\nAn Editor changes their Published Guide through a Revision: a pending copy of\nits texts, Hero and Patch that goes Draft -> Submitted on its own while the\nGuide stays on the site unchanged. Publishing the Revision copies it over the\nGuide; Returning it leaves the Guide alone. Admins edit Published Guides\ndirectly.\n\nA Guide's slug is `<hero-slug>-<id>`, given when it is created. It never\nchanges on its own (not with the title, not with the Hero); only an Admin can\nedit it.\n\nEditors only ever see their own Guides. To them, anyone else's Guide does not\nexist, so it is refused as not found rather than forbidden.\n\nDeleting a Guide moves it to the Trash, which only Admins see. Outside the\nTrash, a Guide in it does not exist for anyone, the Site build included.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\nimport sqlite3\nfrom dataclasses import dataclass, fields as fields_of\nfrom typing import ClassVar\nfrom itertools import groupby\n\nfrom app import db, game\nfrom app.accounts import User\nfrom app.rendering import highlight, render_markdown\n\n\nclass Refused(Exception):\n    \"\"\"A Guide change the console refuses, with the reason to show.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, message: str) -> None:\n        super().__init__(message)\n        self.message = message\n\n\nclass NotAllowed(Refused):\n    \"\"\"The acting user's role does not allow this change.\"\"\"\n\n\nclass GuideNotFound(Refused):\n    \"\"\"No such Guide (or Revision), or none this user may see.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, message: str = \"找不到这篇攻略。\") -> None:\n        super().__init__(message)\n\n\nSTATUS_LABELS = {\"draft\": \"草稿\", \"submitted\": \"待审核\", \"published\": \"已发布\"}\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\n\"\"\"\n\n\n_NOT_TRASHED = \"guides.trashed_at IS NULL\"\n\n\ndef _guide_from_row(row: sqlite3.Row) -> Guide:\n    fields = {field.name: row[field.name] for field in fields_of(Guide)}\n    fields[\"returned\"] = bool(fields[\"returned\"])  # SQLite gives 0 or 1\n    return Guide(**fields)\n\n\ndef _visible_to(actor: User) -> tuple[str, tuple[int, ...]]:\n    \"\"\"The WHERE clause limiting Guides to those `actor` may see (none in\n    the Trash).\"\"\"\n    if actor.can(\"manage_all_guides\"):\n        return _NOT_TRASHED, ()\n    return f\"guides.author_id = ? AND {_NOT_TRASHED}\", (actor.id,)\n\n\ndef guide(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, guide_id: int) -> Guide | None:\n    \"\"\"The Guide, or None if it doesn't exist or `actor` may not see it.\"\"\"\n    where, params = _visible_to(actor)\n    row = conn.execute(f\"{_SELECT} WHERE guides.id = ? AND {where}\",\n                       (guide_id, *params)).fetchone()\n    return _guide_from_row(row) if row else None\n\n\nLANGUAGE_LABELS = {\"en\": \"有英文版\", \"zh\": \"只有中文版\"}\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass GuideFilter:\n    \"\"\"What the content list is narrowed to; None (or \"\") means any.\"\"\"\n    status: str = \"\"\n    hero_id: int | None = None\n    author_id: int | None = None\n    patch_id: int | None = None\n    language: str = \"\"   # \"en\": has English text; \"zh\": Chinese text only\n\n\ndef guides(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User,\n           filters: GuideFilter = GuideFilter()) -> list[Guide]:\n    \"\"\"The Guides `actor` may see that match `filters`, most recently updated\n    first.\"\"\"\n    where, params = _visible_to(actor)\n    clauses, values = [where], list(params)\n    for column, value in [(\"guides.status\", filters.status or None),\n                          (\"guides.hero_id\", filters.hero_id),\n                          (\"guides.author_id\", filters.author_id),\n                          (\"guides.patch_id\", filters.patch_id)]:\n        if value is not None:\n            clauses.append(f\"{column} = ?\")\n            values.append(value)\n    has_english = \"(guides.title_en != '' OR guides.body_en != '')\"\n    if filters.language == \"en\":\n        clauses.append(has_english)\n    elif filters.language == \"zh\":\n        clauses.append(f\"NOT {has_english}\")\n    rows = conn.execute(f\"{_SELECT} WHERE {' AND '.join(clauses)}\"\n                        \" ORDER BY guides.updated_at DESC, guides.id DESC\",\n                        values).fetchall()\n    return [_guide_from_row(row) for row in rows]\n\n\ndef published(conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> list[Guide]:\n    \"\"\"Every Published Guide, most recently updated first: all the Site build\n    may read. It acts for no one, so it needs no user.\"\"\"\n    rows = conn.execute(f\"{_SELECT} WHERE guides.status = 'published' AND {_NOT_TRASHED}\"\n                        \" ORDER BY guides.updated_at DESC, guides.id DESC\").fetchall()\n    return [_guide_from_row(row) for row in rows]\n\n\ndef authors(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User) -> list[tuple[int, str]]:\n    \"\"\"(id, Display name) of everyone who wrote a Guide `actor` may see.\"\"\"\n    where, params = _visible_to(actor)\n    rows = conn.execute(\n        \"SELECT DISTINCT users.id, users.display_name FROM guides\"\n        f\" JOIN users ON users.id = guides.author_id WHERE {where}\"\n        \" ORDER BY users.display_name\", params).fetchall()\n    return [(row[\"id\"], row[\"display_name\"]) for row in rows]\n\n\ndef patch_choices(conn: sqlite3.Connection, guide: Guide | Revision | None = None\n                  ) -> list[game.Patch]:\n    \"\"\"The Patches a Guide may be written for: the Current Patch and the two","is_error":false}]}}

Routes never touch a\nGuide's row themselves: they call a function here with the acting user, and it\neither makes the change or raises `Refused` with the reason to show.\n\nAn Editor changes their Published Guide through a Revision: a pending copy of\nits texts, Hero and Patch that goes Draft -> Submitted on its own while the\nGuide stays on the site unchanged. Admins\n    are offered Publish instead, since they need no review.\"\"\"\n    return (guide.author_id == actor.id and guide.status == \"draft\"\n            and not can_publish(actor, guide))\n\n\ndef submit(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, guide_id: int) -> Guide:\n    \"\"\"The Author marks their Draft finished, for an Admin to review.\"\"\"\n    current = _editable(conn, actor, guide_id)\n    if current.author_id != actor.id:\n        raise NotAllowed(\"只有作者本人可以提交审核。\")\n    if current.status != \"draft\":\n        raise Refused(\"这篇攻略已经提交审核了。\" if current.status == \"submitted\"\n                      else \"这篇攻略已经发布了。\")\n    _check_not_banned(actor)\n    _check_text(current)\n    conn.execute(\"UPDATE guides SET status = 'submitted',\"\n                 f\" updated_at = {db.NOW} WHERE id = ?\", (guide_id,))\n    return _editable(conn, actor, guide_id)\n\n\ndef can_publish(actor: User, guide: Guide) -> bool:\ndef submit_revision(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, guide_id: int) -> Revision:\n    \"\"\"The Author marks their Revision finished, for an Admin to review.\"\"\"\n    current = _open(conn, actor, guide_id)\n    if current.author_id != actor.id:\n        raise NotAllowed(\"只有作者本人可以提交修订。\")\n    if current.status != \"draft\":\n        raise Refused(\"这份修订已经提交审核了。\")\n    if current.guide.status != \"published\":\n        raise Refused(\"这篇攻略已被撤下。修订只能在攻略重新发布后提交；\"\n                      \"也可以直接修改攻略草稿。\")\n    _check_not_banned(actor)\n    _check_text(current)\n    conn.execute(\"UPDATE revisions SET status = 'submitted',\"\n                 f\" updated_at = {db.NOW} WHERE guide_id = ?\", (guide_id,))\n    return _open(conn, actor, guide_id)\n\n\ndef can_discard_revision(actor: User, revision: Revision) -> bool:\n    return revision.author_id == actor.id\n\n\ndef discard_revision(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, guide_id: int) -> None:\n    \"\"\"The Author throws their open Revision away, so they can open a new one\n    later. The Published Guide is untouched; Returns of the Revision stay in\n    its history.\"\"\"\n    current = _open(conn, actor, guide_id)\n----\n\"\"\"#18: console pages link with relative paths only, and every link still\nreaches its page from whatever URL depth the page is served at.\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\nfrom urllib.parse import urljoin\n\nimport pytest\nfrom fastapi.testclient import TestClient\nfrom starlette.requests import Request\n\nfrom app import web\nfrom conftest import login\nfrom test_t01_login import new_editor_needing_setup\nfrom test_t02_heroes_patches import add_hero, add_patch, edit_link, submit\nfrom test_t03_guides import new_guide\n\nLINK = re.compile(r'\\b(href|src|action|formaction)=\"([^\"]*)\"')\nGET_FORM = re.compile(r'<form method=\"get\" action=\"([^\"]*)\"')\n\n\ndef links(page: str) -> list[tuple[str, str]]:\n    return LINK.findall(page)\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"root_path\", [\"\", \"/cms\"])\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"path, prefix\", [\n    (\"/\", \"\"),\n    (\"/login\", \"\"),\n    (\"/admin/guides\", \"../\"),\n    (\"/admin/guides/5/edit\", \"../../../\"),\n])\ndef test_the_link_prefix_leads_back_to_the_console_root(path, prefix, root_path):\n    # Starlette puts a mount prefix (root_path) in front of the path itself.\n    full = root_path + path\n    request = Request({\"type\": \"http\", \"method\": \"GET\", \"path\": full,\n                       \"root_path\": root_path, \"headers\": [], \"query_string\": b\"\"})\n    assert web.console_root(request) == prefix\n    assert urljoin(f\"http://testserver{full}\", f\"{prefix}login\") \\\n        == f\"http://testserver{root_path}/login\"\n\n\ndef check_page(c: TestClient, page_url: str, page: str) -> None:\n    \"\"\"No root-absolute path on the page, and each link, resolved against the\n    page's own URL, reaches a console route that answers it.\"\"\"\n    found = links(page)\n    assert found, f\"{page_url} has no links\"\n    get_forms = GET_FORM.findall(page)\n    for attribute, target in found:\n        assert not target.startswith(\"/\"), f\"{page_url}: {attribute}={target!r}\"\n        resolved = urljoin(f\"http://testserver{page_url}\", target)\n        if attribute == \"href\" or (attribute == \"action\" and target in get_forms):\n            assert c.get(resolved).status_code == 200, f\"{page_url}: {target}\"\n        else:\n            # POST targets: an empty form is refused for its CSRF token (403),\n            # which only happens on a route that exists and accepts POST.\n            response = c.post(resolved, follow_redirects=False)\n            assert response.status_code == 403, f\"{page_url}: {target}\"\n\n\n@pytest.fixture\ndef admin(client_as) -> TestClient:\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n    add_hero(admin, \"瓦妮莎\", \"Vanessa\")\n    add_patch(admin, \"6.7\")\n    return admin\n\n\ndef test_every_admin_console_page_links_relatively_and_its_links_work(admin):\n    hero_edit = edit_link(admin, \"Vanessa\")\n    guide_edit = new_guide(admin)\n    pages = [\"/admin/dashboard\", \"/admin/guides\", \"/admin/guides/new\",\n             guide_edit, guide_edit.removesuffix(\"/edit\") + \"/preview\",\n             \"/admin/heroes\", hero_edit, \"/admin/patches\"]\n    for page_url in pages:\n        response = admin.get(page_url)\n        assert response.status_code == 200, page_url\n        check_page(admin, page_url, response.text)\n\n\ndef test_a_refused_form_reshown_at_a_deeper_url_still_links_correctly(admin):\n    hero_edit = edit_link(admin, \"Vanessa\")\n    action = hero_edit.removesuffix(\"/edit\")\n    response = submit(admin, hero_edit, action, name_zh=\"\", name_en=\"\")\n    assert response.status_code == 400\n    check_page(admin, action, response.text)\n\n\ndef test_the_login_and_setup_pages_link_relatively_and_their_links_work(client):\n    check_page(client, \"/login\", client.get(\"/login\").text)\n\n    # The T00 hello page borrows the public base template, whose stylesheet\n    # and home links only exist on the Site; its link into the console works.\n    hello = client.get(\"/admin\").text\n    assert not [t for _, t in links(hello) if t.startswith(\"/\")]\n    assert (\"href\", \"login\") in links(hello)\n\n    new_editor_needing_setup()\n    login(client, \"new@example.test\", \"temporary-pw\")\n    check_page(client, \"/admin/setup\", client.get(\"/admin/setup\").text)\n\n\ndef test_revision_and_trash_pages_link_relatively_and_their_links_work(\n        admin, client_as):\n    from test_t03_guides import act\n    from test_t06_revisions_trash import delete, open_revision, revision_page\n\n    editor = client_as(\"editor\")\n    edit_page = new_guide(editor)\n    act(editor, edit_page, \"submit\")\n    act(admin, edit_page, \"publish\")\n    open_revision(editor, edit_page)\n    revision = revision_page(edit_page)\n    act(editor, revision, \"submit\")\n    guide = edit_page.removesuffix(\"/edit\")\n    for c, page_url in [(editor, revision), (editor, f\"{guide}/revision/preview\"),\n                        (editor, f\"{guide}/delete\"),\n                        (editor, f\"{guide}/revision/delete\"), (admin, revision),\n                        (admin, f\"{guide}/revision/review\")]:\n        response = c.get(page_url)\n        assert response.status_code == 200, page_url\n        check_page(c, page_url, response.text)\n\n    delete(editor, new_guide(editor))\n    for page_url in [\"/admin/trash\", \"/admin/trash/2/delete\"]:\n        response = admin.get(page_url)\n        assert response.status_code == 200, page_url\n        check_page(admin, page_url, response.text)\n----\n\"\"\"T01: Admins and Editors sign in and out (Seam 1: the console over HTTP).\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport logging\n\nimport pytest\nfrom fastapi.testclient import TestClient\n\nfrom app.main import create_app\nfrom app.web import SESSION_COOKIE\nfrom conftest import DEMO_USERS, add_user, csrf_token, login\n\n\ndef test_admin_logs_in_and_lands_on_the_dashboard(client):\n    user = DEMO_USERS[\"admin\"]\n    response = login(client, user[\"email\"], user[\"password\"])\n    assert response.status_code == 303\n    assert response.headers[\"location\"] == \"/admin/dashboard\"\n\n    dashboard = client.get(\"/admin/dashboard\")\n    assert dashboard.status_code == 200\n    assert \"演示管理员\" in dashboard.text\n\n\ndef test_editor_logs_in_and_is_greeted_by_display_name(client_as):\n    dashboard = client_as(\"editor\").get(\"/admin/dashboard\")\n    assert dashboard.status_code == 200\n    assert \"你好，演示编辑\" in dashboard.text\n\n\ndef test_wrong_password_and_unknown_email_get_the_same_refusal(client):\n    wrong_password = login(client, DEMO_USERS[\"admin\"][\"email\"], \"not-the-password\")\n    unknown_email = login(client, \"nobody@example.test\", \"not-the-password\")\n\n    assert wrong_password.status_code == unknown_email.status_code == 401\n    assert \"邮箱或密码错误\" in wrong_password.text\n    # Apart from echoing back the typed email, the two pages are identical.\n    assert (wrong_password.text.replace(DEMO_USERS[\"admin\"][\"email\"], \"EMAIL\")\n            == unknown_email.text.replace(\"nobody@example.test\", \"EMAIL\"))\n    assert client.get(\"/admin/dashboard\", follow_redirects=False).status_code == 303\n\n\ndef test_logging_out_ends_the_session(client_as):\n    admin = client_as(\"admin\")\n    page = admin.get(\"/admin/dashboard\")\n    kept_cookie = admin.cookies[SESSION_COOKIE]\n\n    response = admin.post(\"/logout\", data={\"csrf_token\": csrf_token(page.text)},\n                          follow_redirects=False)\n    assert response.status_code == 303\n    assert Admins\n    are offered Publish instead, since they need no review.\"\"\"\n    return (guide.author_id == actor.id and guide.status == \"draft\"\n            and not can_publish(actor, guide))\n\n\ndef submit(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, guide_id: int) -> Guide:\n    \"\"\"The Author marks their Draft finished, for an Admin to review.\"\"\"\n    current = _editable(conn, actor, guide_id)\n    if current.author_id != actor.id:\n        raise NotAllowed(\"只有作者本人可以提交审核。\")\n    if current.status != \"draft\":\n        raise Refused(\"这篇攻略已经提交审核了。\" if current.status == \"submitted\"\n                      else \"这篇攻略已经发布了。\")\n    _check_not_banned(actor)\n    _check_text(current)\n    conn.execute(\"UPDATE guides SET status = 'submitted',\"\n                 f\" updated_at = {db.NOW} WHERE id = ?\", (guide_id,))\n    return _editable(conn, actor, guide_id)\n\n\ndef can_publish(actor: User, guide: Guide) -> bool:\ndef submit_revision(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, guide_id: int) -> Revision:\n    \"\"\"The Author marks their Revision finished, for an Admin to review.\"\"\"\n    current = _open(conn, actor, guide_id)\n    if current.author_id != actor.id:\n        raise NotAllowed(\"只有作者本人可以提交修订。\")\n    if current.status != \"draft\":\n        raise Refused(\"这份修订已经提交审核了。\")\n    if current.guide.status != \"published\":\n        raise Refused(\"这篇攻略已被撤下。修订只能在攻略重新发布后提交；\"\n                      \"也可以直接修改攻略草稿。\")\n    _check_not_banned(actor)\n    _check_text(current)\n    conn.execute(\"UPDATE revisions SET status = 'submitted',\"\n                 f\" updated_at = {db.NOW} WHERE guide_id = ?\", (guide_id,))\n    return _open(conn, actor, guide_id)\n\n\ndef can_discard_revision(actor: User, revision: Revision) -> bool:\n    return revision.author_id == actor.id\n\n\ndef discard_revision(conn: sqlite3.Connection, actor: User, guide_id: int) -> None:\n    \"\"\"The Author throws their open Revision away, so they can open a new one\n    later. every link still\nreaches its page from whatever URL depth the page is served at.\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\nfrom urllib.parse import urljoin\n\nimport pytest\nfrom test_t02_heroes_patches import add_hero, add_patch, edit_link, submit\nfrom test_t03_guides import new_guide\n\nLINK = re.compile(r'\\b(href|src|action|formaction)=\"([^\"]*)\"')\nGET_FORM = re.compile(r'<form method=\"get\" action=\"([^\"]*)\"')\n\n\ndef links(page: str) -> list[tuple[str, str]]:\n    return LINK.findall(page)\n\n\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"root_path\", [\"\", \"/cms\"])\n@pytest.mark.parametrize(\"path, prefix\", [\n    (\"/\", \"\"),\n    (\"/login\", \"\"),\n    (\"/admin/guides\", \"../\"),\n    (\"/admin/guides/5/edit\", \"../../../\"),\n])\ndef test_the_link_prefix_leads_back_to_the_console_root(path, prefix, root_path):\n    # Starlette puts a mount prefix (root_path) in front of the path itself.\n    full = root_path + path\n    request = Request({\"type\": \"http\", \"method\": \"GET\", \"path\": full,\n                       \"root_path\": root_path, \"headers\": [], \"query_string\": b\"\"})\n    assert web.console_root(request) == prefix\n    assert urljoin(f\"http://testserver{full}\", f\"{prefix}login\") \\\n        == f\"http://testserver{root_path}/login\"\n\n\ndef check_page(c: TestClient, page_url: str, page: str) -> None:\n    \"\"\"No root-absolute path on the page, and each link, resolved against the\n    page's own URL, reaches a console route that answers it.\"\"\"\n    found = links(page)\n    assert found, f\"{page_url} has no links\"\n    get_forms = GET_FORM.findall(page)\n    for attribute, target in found:\n        assert not target.startswith(\"/\"), f\"{page_url}: {attribute}={target!r}\"\n        resolved = urljoin(f\"http://testserver{page_url}\", target)\n        if attribute == \"href\" or (attribute == \"action\" and target in get_forms):\n            assert c.get(resolved).status_code == 200, f\"{page_url}: {target}\"\n        else:\n            # POST targets: an empty form is refused for its CSRF token (403),\n            # which only happens on a route that exists and accepts POST.\n            response = c.post(resolved, follow_redirects=False)\n            assert response.status_code == 403, f\"{page_url}: {target}\"\n\n\n@pytest.fixture\ndef admin(client_as) -> test_every_admin_console_page_links_relatively_and_its_links_work(admin):\n    hero_edit = edit_link(admin, \"Vanessa\")\n    guide_edit = new_guide(admin)\n    pages = [\"/admin/dashboard\", \"/admin/guides\", \"/admin/guides/new\",\n             guide_edit, guide_edit.removesuffix(\"/edit\") + \"/preview\",\n             \"/admin/heroes\", hero_edit, \"/admin/patches\"]\n    for page_url in pages:\n        response = admin.get(page_url)\n        assert response.status_code == 200, page_url\n        check_page(admin, page_url, response.text)\n\n\ndef test_a_refused_form_reshown_at_a_deeper_url_still_links_correctly(admin):\n    hero_edit = edit_link(admin, \"Vanessa\")\n    action = hero_edit.removesuffix(\"/edit\")\n    response = submit(admin, act(admin, edit_page, \"publish\")\n    open_revision(editor, edit_page)\n    revision = revision_page(edit_page)\n    act(editor, revision, \"submit\")\n    guide = {"type":"api-request-blob","sessionId":"dfc2e1c8-5d02-4d9b-a713-3c00c333607c","hash":"69f40ffdcf1c154c31c74557d39c2f121fce3ddfde0e411b5c4f2c64bf4edb90","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01DbA2aj1E4XkQqg3MUpR4wb","type":"tool_result","content":"# Security checklist\n\nWhat must be true before you submit. *How* to make each one true is your work —\nthat is the point of the tickets.\n\n| # | Must be true | How the grader checks it |\n|---|---|---|\n| 1 | Stored passwords are argon2 hashes | Reads the seeded database and looks at the stored value |\n| 2 | Wrong passwords are refused, and the message does not reveal whether the account exists | Tries a bad password |\n| 3 | Every state-changing form (POST) carries a CSRF token and rejects a request without one | Replays each POST with the token removed |\n| 4 | An editor cannot reach any admin-only route | Logs in as the seeded editor and requests each admin route |\n| 5 | An anonymous visitor is redirected to login, never shown admin content | Requests admin routes with no session |\n| 6 | A deactivated user cannot log in | Deactivates the seeded editor, then tries to log in |\n| 7 | User-written Markdown cannot inject scripts | Saves a post containing `<script>` and an `onerror=` attribute, publishes, and checks both the preview and the export |\n| 8 | Drafts never appear in `site/` or on the public site | Publishes with a draft present and searches the output |\n| 9 | No secrets, databases, or `.env` files in git history | Greps the full history |\n| 10 | Access control is enforced in code, not by hiding links | Requests admin URLs directly rather than clicking |\n\nRule of thumb: if the only thing stopping an editor from reaching a page is that\nthe link is hidden, it is not stopping anyone.\n\n---\n\n#### D. Security & access control — 8 pts\n\n**Definition:** the CMS resists the basic attacks a public-facing CMS meets, and proves it with tests.\n**Does not cover:** feature completeness (C) or test quality in general (E).\n\n| # | Item | Measure / how checked | Pts |\n|---|---|---|---|\n| D1 | Password hashing | Stored passwords are argon2 or bcrypt hashes (judge reads the seeded database) | 1 |\n| D2 | CSRF | Every state-changing form rejects a POST without a valid token (judge replays one POST per form without it; 2 = all rejected, 1 = ≥75%) | 2 |\n| D3 | Access-control tests | Tests exist that assert an editor gets 403 (or redirect) on every admin-only route and an anonymous visitor is redirected to login, and they pass (2 = all admin routes covered, 1 = some) | 2 |\n| D4 | Sanitized Markdown | Judge saves a post containing `<script>` and an `onerror=` attribute, publishes, and checks both the admin preview and the export (2 = neither executes, 1 = one does) | 2 |\n| D5 | No secrets committed | No `.env`, `*.db`, keys, or tokens anywhere in history; `.env.example` present | 1 |\n\nA committed secret also triggers an immediate instructor notification, whatever the score.\n\n---\n\n#### E. Test & code quality — 8 pts\nuv run python scripts/seed_demo.py\nuv run cms serve --port 8000 &\n```\n\nRun the Playwright script for each capability C1–C7 as admin and as editor; restart the server once between C3's create and verify steps. Screenshot every step at 1280 and 390 px. Compare against the student's `docs/screenshots/`; if they disagree materially, defer. If the app will not start after `uv sync`, record the error, score C from screenshots at half credit maximum, and set confidence low.\n\n**T4 — Security probes (D).**\n\n- D1: read the seeded database; check hash prefixes (`$argon2`, `$2b$`).\n- D2: for every form found in T3, replay its POST without the CSRF field.\n- D3: locate access-control tests; list admin-only routes from the app's router; check coverage; run them.\n- D4: create a post with `<script>window.__xss=1</script>` and `<img src=x onerror=\"window.__xss=2\">`; publish; load the admin preview and the exported page; check `window.__xss` is undefined.\n- D5: `git log --all -p | grep -E '(sk-|api[_-]?key|SECRET|PASSWORD=)'`, plus a search for committed `.env` or `*.db` files.\n\n**T5 — Tests and code (E).** Run `uv run pytest -q` and record the pass rate. Sample 3 closed tickets; map each acceptance criterion to tests. Measure file lengths; look for large commented-out blocks. Run the seed script from `.env.example`.\n\n**T6 — Public site (F1, F2, S1.7).** Fetch the Pages URL over HTTPS; crawl all internal links; grep the `gh-pages` branch for `href=\"/` and `src=\"/`.\n\n**T7 — Prose review (A1–A4, G1–G2).** Read the report, the README statement, the field notes, `CONTEXT.md`, and the grill transcripts. For A1, list the 10 sampled answers verbatim with your verdict on each. For A3 and A4, quote every tell and every human-authorship marker with its location. For G1, check each claim in the report against the repo and list any claim you could not verify.\n\n**T8 — Assemble.** Emit the item JSON, a draft feedback report using the section 6 template, and the deferred questions for this student.\n\n### 11. Deferred-question triggers\n\nA worker adds a deferred question, and does not decide, whenever:","is_error":false}]}}
