{"parentUuid":"8fbb39a6-d641-4c9d-b4dc-a0a19696cb41","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-opus-5-5","id":"msg_011Cg8oxJRFj9TJiS7efyccY","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"T09 is built, tested and committed, and PR #24 is open: https://github.com/Avulpix0412/iphs400-mp2-cms/pull/24. I haven't merged it. Say the word and I'll merge it with a merge commit as before; merging closes #10.\n\n**What the Users page does**\n- **List:** every account with its Display name, email, role, state, Guide counts (Trash left out) and last login.\n- **Create:** an Admin adds an account with a temporary password they type in, and the new user must complete first-login setup.\n- **Per-account page:** change the role (takes effect on the user's next request), apply or lift a Submission ban, reset the password, and deactivate (after a confirmation page) or reactivate.\n- **Lockout guards:** an Admin can't demote, deactivate or reset themselves, and the last active Admin can't be removed.\n\n**For the security checklist**\n- **Item 6 (deactivated user can't log in):** the grader can now deactivate the seeded editor on the Users page. Their open session ends at once and logging in is refused with \"账号已停用\".\n- **D3 (editor refused on every admin route):** one test finds every route behind an Admin-only guard, 21 today, and checks that an Editor gets 403 and a signed-out visitor is sent to `/login`. Admin routes added in T07 or T08 will be covered without editing the test.\n- **The page an Editor sees when refused:** it's now a console page with the navigation and logout, still status 403.\n\n**Behaviour changes outside the Users page**\n- **Revisions under a ban:** a banned Editor can no longer open a Revision; before, only Submit checked the ban. They also see the ban notice on every console page before pressing anything.\n- **Account changes during review:** a ban, unban, reactivation or promotion can no longer undo a change another Admin made to the same account at the same moment. The review found this; each change now checks the account's state as part of the database update.\n\n**Testing:** all 263 tests pass and pyright reports 0 errors. I removed a T01 test and the `accounts.set_state` helper, because the T09 deactivation test covers the same thing through the real Users page. The users table now has a `last_login_at` column, added the same additive way as T06's columns; a test confirms a database from before T09 still works.\n\n**Review:** the `/code-review` gave 10 findings. I fixed eight and left two:\n- **Error classes:** `accounts` and `guides` each have their own refusal classes. Merging them is a refactor across all the Guide routes, so I left it for later.\n- **Per-account Guide count:** showing one account's count scans every Author's Guides, which costs nothing at this site's size.\n\nThe findings and their resolutions, plus the decisions the spec didn't settle, are posted on #10: https://github.com/Avulpix0412/iphs400-mp2-cms/issues/10#issuecomment-6244062410\n\nTwo decisions you may want to revisit:\n- **Ban lost on reactivation:** reactivating an account returns it to the normal state, so a ban from before the deactivation is dropped. The confirmation page says so.\n- **Times in UTC:** last-login times show in UTC, like every other console timestamp.\n\nTranscript 14, the T06 handoff and the usage-ledger update are committed separately. Their only matches against your `.env` files were the database filename, site title and student name, none of them secrets."}],"container":null,"stop_reason":"end_turn","stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":2155,"cache_read_input_tokens":236305,"output_tokens":1132,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":29},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":2155,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"global","iterations":[{"input_tokens":2,"output_tokens":1132,"cache_read_input_tokens":236305,"cache_creation_input_tokens":2155,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":2155},"type":"message"}],"speed":"standard","fallback_credit":null},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"apiBlockIndex":1,"requestId":"req_011Cg8oxJ6RF5TZ16g7pEzkR","requestRef":"98b265b4-1e58-4870-859e-d12af599cbd8","requestedModel":"claude-opus-5-5","attributionSkill":"mattpocock-skills:pr","attributionPlugin":"mattpocock-skills","type":"assistant","uuid":"0053a9bd-b6bf-4c47-b289-857f6513c921","timestamp":"2026-10-18T01:09:57.468Z","advisorModel":"claude-opus-5-5","effort":"high","perTurnEffort":"high","session_id":"dfc2e1c8-5d02-4d9b-a713-3c00c333607c","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/Users/yining/orca/workspaces/iphs400-mp2-cms/IPHS400-Mini-Project-2","sessionId":"dfc2e1c8-5d02-4d9b-a713-3c00c333607c","version":"2.1.302","gitBranch":"Avulpix0412/IPHS400-Mini-Project-2"}

The Admins, Editors and most Readers are in China, so every time reads 8 hours early. On the site, a Guide updated between 00:00 and 08:00 Beijing time is dated the day before.\n\nThe times are stored in UTC (SQLite `strftime(... 'now')` / `CURRENT_TIMESTAMP`) and printed as stored. Some pages also show the raw value with milliseconds.\n\n## Where times are shown\n\n**Public site:**\n- `templates/site/guide.html`: 更新于 / Updated date on each Guide\n- `templates/site/_guides.html`: date in each Guide list item (home, Hero and Author pages)\n\n**Console:**\n- `templates/admin/dashboard.html`: review queue 更新于\n- `templates/admin/guides.html`: content list (raw value with milliseconds)\n- `templates/admin/guide_edit.html`, `templates/admin/revision_edit.html`: 更新于 (raw value with milliseconds)\n- `templates/admin/guide_review.html`, `templates/admin/revision_edit.html`: \"攻略又被修改过（更新于 …）\" warning\n- `templates/admin/_review_notes.html`: when each Return / Unpublish happened\n- `templates/admin/trash.html`: 删除于\n- `templates/admin/users.html`, `templates/admin/user.html`: 上次登录\n\n## What to build\n\nShow every console and site time in Beijing time (UTC+8, `Asia/Shanghai`), in one consistent format. Keep storing UTC: the \"changes not yet on the site\" count compares stored timestamps with the last Site build, so only the display changes.\n\n## Acceptance criteria\n\n- [ ] Every console time listed above is shown in Beijing time, in the same format (e.g. `2026-10-17 21:05`, with no milliseconds).\n- [ ] Guide dates on the public site (Chinese and English trees) are Beijing dates: a Guide updated at 2026-10-17 17:30 UTC shows 2026-10-18.\n- [ ] Stored timestamps stay UTC, and the \"N 项更改尚未更新到网站\" count still works.\n- [ ] One conversion function is used everywhere, so a new page can't show UTC by accident.\nEOF\ngh issue create --title \"Show console and site times in Beijing time, not UTC\" --body-file $SP/beijing-time-issue.md","description":"Open unlabelled issue for Beijing time display"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"container":null,"stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":1388,"cache_read_input_tokens":239697,"output_tokens":1279,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":218},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":1388,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"global","iterations":[{"input_tokens":2,"output_tokens":1279,"cache_read_input_tokens":239697,"cache_creation_input_tokens":1388,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":1388},"type":"message"}],"speed":"standard","fallback_credit":null},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"wireToolInputs":{"toolu_01EniePXpdqAJS2kCNFesQz9":{"command":"SP=/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-yining-orca-workspaces-iphs400-mp2-cms-IPHS400-Mini-Project-2/dfc2e1c8-5d02-4d9b-a713-3c00c333607c/scratchpad\ncat > $SP/beijing-time-issue.md <<'EOF'\n## Problem\n\nEvery time the console and the public site show is in UTC. {"parentUuid":"f2687515-9551-4390-8bb3-39cbbbc2fa40","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-opus-5-5","id":"msg_011Cg8pgZLcDtEksRsPZyFv5","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01MoFwRZUkm1F7jsLYtcCBSV","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/Users/yining/orca/workspaces/iphs400-mp2-cms/IPHS400-Mini-Project-2/docs/handoff/03_t09-to-next_20261017.md","content":"# Handoff: 大巴扎攻略站 CMS, after T09\n\nRepo: `/Users/yining/orca/workspaces/iphs400-mp2-cms/IPHS400-Mini-Project-2` (a git worktree on branch\n`Avulpix0412/IPHS400-Mini-Project-2`, reused for every ticket; do not delete it after merging).\nThe main checkout is `/Users/yining/code/iphs400-mp2-cms` (on `main`), which holds the real local `cms.db`.\n\n## Where things stand\n\n- **T09 (#10) is done, merged and closed.** PR: https://github.com/Avulpix0412/iphs400-mp2-cms/pull/24\n  (merge commit `2d18948`). The PR body has the state diagram, file map, test evidence and merge danger.\n- The `/code-review` findings, how each was resolved, and the decisions the spec left open are in\n  https://github.com/Avulpix0412/iphs400-mp2-cms/issues/10#issuecomment-6244062410\n- The user took T09 ahead of T07 because several security-checklist items (`SECURITY-CHECKLIST.md`) can only be\n  checked once the Users page exists: #4 (Editor refused on Admin routes), #6 (deactivated user can't log in),\n  #10 (enforced in code, not by hidden links).\n- At handoff, 263 tests passed and pyright reported 0 errors. The branch was pushed and its commits are in `main`.\n  This handoff file is not committed yet. It goes into the next \"Add transcript NN\" commit, with transcript 15\n  and the usage-ledger rows.\n\n## Next tickets (open issues; ask the user which one to take)\n\n- **#8 T07: Game Terms with Official names in every Guide** (`[[term]]` rendering, preview warnings, CSV import).\n- **#9 T08: Pages and Tournament items appear in the public navigation.**\n- **#25: Show console and site times in Beijing time, not UTC.** The user asked for it at the end of this session.\n  It has no labels on purpose, because the problem is in many places, not one ticket. The issue lists every place a\n  time is shown. Times stay stored in UTC, because `changes_not_on_site` compares stored timestamps.\n- #11 S1 images (stretch) · #12 S2 hosted console (stretch, last; ADR-003 supersedes ADR-001 then).\n\nRead the ticket, spec #1 (`gh issue view 1`), and `CONTEXT.md` before coding, as `CLAUDE.md` requires.\n\n## What the next tickets must fit around (from T09, not obvious from the spec)\n\n- **Admin-only guards come from `web.requires(capability)`** (`app/web.py`).\n  - Make one guard per capability at module level, e.g. `user_manager = requires(\"manage_users\")`, so FastAPI's\n    per-request dependency cache recognises it.\n  - Each guard is registered in `web.ADMIN_GUARDS`. The test\n    `test_an_editor_is_refused_on_every_admin_only_route` (`tests/test_t09_users.py`) walks every router module\n    under `app/routes/` and finds the routes guarded by one. A new route behind `requires(...)` is covered\n    automatically (rubric D3), with no test edit.\n  - A route that refuses *inside its body* (`raise AdminRequired(user)`, as the review pages in\n    `app/routes/guides.py` do) is **not** found by that walk. Prefer the dependency.\n  - T07 (Game Terms) and T08 (Pages, Tournament items) should guard their routes with `requires(...)`, either with\n    an existing capability (`manage_game`) or a new one added to `CAPABILITIES` in `app/accounts.py`.\n- **`AdminRequired(user)` now carries the user.** The 403 renders `templates/admin/refused.html` with the console\n  navigation.\n- **Account changes live in `app/accounts.py`** (user-management section at the bottom).\n  - Each change repeats its precondition in its UPDATE (`_update(..., refusal)`, `CHANGED_MEANWHILE`).\n  - The last-active-Admin guard is the SQL fragment `_KEEPS_AN_ADMIN`.\n  - Follow the same pattern for any new change that a concurrent edit could overwrite.\n- **Submission ban:**\n  - `accounts.SUBMISSION_BANNED` is both the refusal reason and a notice that `base.html` shows on every console\n    page to a banned user.\n  - The ban blocks Submit, opening a Revision, and Submitting a Revision.\n- **Template globals:** `min_password_length` and `submission_banned` (next to `console_root`, `csrf_token`).\n- **Wide tables:** wrap them in `<div class=\"scroll\">` (CSS in `base.html`). On a phone the table then scrolls\n  sideways instead of wrapping one character per line. The Users table does this. The Guide list and the Trash\n  don't yet.\n- **Schema:** `users.last_login_at` was added through `ADDED_COLUMNS`. The test\n  `test_a_database_made_before_the_users_page_still_works` shows the pattern for a table that predates a column.\n- **Per-user Guide counts:** `guides.counts_by_author` (requires `manage_users`; Trash excluded).\n- **Removed:** `accounts.set_state` is gone. Arrange account states in tests with `conftest.add_user(..., state=...)`\n  or through the Users page.\n- **Known debt, deliberately left (see the #10 comment):**\n  - `accounts` and `guides` each have their own `Refused` / `NotAllowed` and `status_for`.\n  - The account page counts every Author's Guides just to read one Author's counts.\n\n## Working conventions\n\nEverything in `docs/handoff/01_t05-to-t06_20261017.md` and `docs/handoff/02_t06-to-next_20261017.md` (\"Working\nconventions\") still holds:\n- the typecheck and test commands,\n- the review comment before the closing commit,\n- the commit and PR style,\n- the transcript commits and credential scan,\n- `/browse` for visual checks,\n- adding each new console page to `tests/test_console_links.py`.\n\nAdditions this session:\n- **T09 test helpers** in `tests/test_t09_users.py`:\n  - `user_row`, `account_page`, `manage(admin, email, action, **fields)`, `create_account`, `second_admin`;\n  - the constants `EDITOR` and `ADMIN`;\n  - `console_routes()` and `admin_only_routes()`.\n- **One agreed exception to Seam 1:** `test_the_last_active_admin_can_never_be_deactivated_or_demoted` calls\n  `app/accounts.py` directly with a stale Admin, because no HTTP request can reach that guard. The user approved\n  this; don't add more without asking.\n- **FastAPI here wraps included routers lazily** (`_IncludedRouter`), so `create_app().routes` doesn't list\n  ticket routes. Walk each module's `router.routes` instead.\n- **zsh doesn't word-split `$VAR`.** Put file lists in an array (`FILES=(...)`, then `\"${FILES[@]}\"`), e.g. for\n  the credential scan.\n- **Credential scan:** `.env` hits on `CMS_DATABASE` (`cms.db`), `CMS_SITE_TITLE` and `CMS_STUDENT` are expected.\n  They are not secrets. Only a hit on a password or key variable blocks a commit.\n- **`/browse` screenshots:**\n  - `file://` only opens files under the working directory or `$TMPDIR`. Copy saved pages into `.gstack/`\n    (git-ignored) first.\n  - The script that saved T09's pages lived in the session scratchpad, which is gone. Recreate it the same way:\n    1. Point `CMS_DATABASE` at a temporary database.\n    2. Seed users with `accounts.create_user`.\n    3. Drive the console with `TestClient`, using `conftest.login` and `test_t02_heroes_patches.submit`.\n    4. Write each page's HTML to a file.\n- **Before claiming a page works on phones,** check `document.documentElement.scrollWidth` at 390px.\n\n## Suggested skills\n\n- `mattpocock-skills:tdd`: red→green per slice at Seam 1 (console over HTTP) and Seam 2 (`render_site`). Confirm\n  any seam beyond those with the user first.\n- `code-review` (built-in, runs in the background): post its findings, and how each was resolved, on the issue\n  before the closing commit.\n- `mattpocock-skills:pr`: the PR body template used for #22, #23 and #24.\n- `browse`: visual check of new console or site pages at 1280 and 390 px (never the `mcp__claude-in-chrome__*`\n  tools, per the user's global `CLAUDE.md`).\n- `mattpocock-skills:domain-modeling`: if a ticket brings new terms (T07's nicknames, T08's Page and Tournament\n  states), to update `CONTEXT.md`.\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"container":null,"stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":4,"cache_creation_input_tokens":417,"cache_read_input_tokens":242746,"output_tokens":3882,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":680},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":417,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"global","iterations":[{"input_tokens":4,"output_tokens":3882,"cache_read_input_tokens":242746,"cache_creation_input_tokens":417,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":417},"type":"message"}],"speed":"standard","fallback_credit":null},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"wireToolInputs":{"toolu_01MoFwRZUkm1F7jsLYtcCBSV":{"file_path":"/Users/yining/orca/workspaces/iphs400-mp2-cms/IPHS400-Mini-Project-2/docs/handoff/03_t09-to-next_20261017.md","content":"# Handoff: 大巴扎攻略站 CMS, after T09\n\nRepo: `/Users/yining/orca/workspaces/iphs400-mp2-cms/IPHS400-Mini-Project-2` (a git worktree on branch\n`Avulpix0412/IPHS400-Mini-Project-2`, reused for every ticket;
